_provenance.method: Street walk between two curated pubs: snap leg + shortest street path + snap leg, never below the straight line. Every pair within the straight-line cap; a pub more than MAX_SNAP_M from a street has no pairs.
_provenance.venues: public/data/venues_slim.json (curated pins inside the street-walk area)
